name: Enbridge Gas Ohio
notes: Researched from public enbridgegas.com/ohio pages only. My Account (Manage Your Account) payments from a bank account are free; Payment > From Your Bank Account, Payment Date Now or Later (Later = a future business day, bank only; no published maximum). Card and PayPal payments are one-time payments through Paymentus at $1.65 residential per transaction, residential card payments capped at $1,000 each and limited to five in three days or ten in 30 days (the format cannot express a per-card cap below $5,000 or velocity limits). Bank payments in My Account are blocked after two returned payments in 12 months (not expressible). AutoPay (formerly Automatic Bank Draft) is bank only and drafts 10-21 days after the bill date on a day the customer chooses (the format has a single daysAfterBill, so the AutoPay day is left to the family default). AutoPay cancel steps are not published (online cancel inferred). Payment plans are by phone (1-800-362-7557), so payment_arrangement is unsupported online. Stop service is online after sign-in for 13-digit account numbers, with at least 7 business days notice recommended. Pay by phone 1-833-261-1469 ($1.65). Amazon Pay retired Sept. 15, 2025. Sign-in identifier and MFA not documented (family defaults kept). Reviewer: the public pages direct payment-plan requests to 1-800-362-7557 and never describe an online arrangement tool (the Budget Billing page mentions arrangements and extensions without saying how), so payment_arrangement offline is inferred.

autopay_cancel.note: Sign in to Manage Your Account to change your AutoPay day or account, or to stop AutoPay.

scheduled_payment.note: Choose Later under Payment Date to pay from your bank account on a future business day. Card payments cannot be scheduled.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are set up by phone. Call 1-800-362-7557, Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., to discuss a plan or assistance.

cancel_service.note: Give at least 7 business days notice if you can. Accounts with a 5-digit account number must contact us to stop service.

notes: Authorized payment centers charge $1.50 per in-person payment, paid in cash.

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Paying from your checking or savings account in Manage Your Account is free: choose Payment, then From Your Bank Account, and pick Now or Later under Payment Date. Bank payments made before 5 p.m. Eastern on a business day post the same day.

Credit card, debit card and PayPal payments are one-time payments processed by Paymentus for a $1.65 fee per residential transaction, up to $1,000 per payment, with no more than five payments in three days or ten in 30 days.

You can also pay by phone at 1-833-261-1469 ($1.65 fee), at an authorized payment center ($1.50 fee, cash), or by mailing a check with your account number to Enbridge Gas Ohio, PO Box 88783, Chicago, IL 60680-1783. Amazon Pay is no longer accepted.

help.title: AutoPay
paragraphs: AutoPay, formerly called Automatic Bank Draft, is free and takes your payment from a checking or savings account 10 to 21 days after your bill date. You pick the day that suits you and can change it later.
Sign in to Manage Your Account to enroll or make changes.

help.title: eBill
paragraphs: With eBill you get an email each time a new bill is posted, with a summary and a link to the full bill, and paper bills stop. Bills stay available online for up to 12 months.
If your account becomes past due, a turn-off notice is still mailed to you. eBill works together with AutoPay and Budget Billing.

help.title: Scheduling a payment
paragraphs: Bank payments can be dated for a future business day by choosing Later. A scheduled payment can be changed or cancelled until 5 p.m. Eastern the day before it is due to process; a Pay now payment cannot be cancelled once submitted.

help.title: Billing options and assistance
paragraphs: Call 1-800-362-7557 to talk about a payment plan or help paying.

PIPP Plus lets income-eligible customers pay 5% of household income toward the gas bill ($10 minimum); Graduate PIPP Plus helps former PIPP customers catch up over 12 months. HEAP gives a one-time heating credit, the Dollar Energy Program offers a one-time grant of up to $300 toward a past-due balance, and the Heat Care Program is a last-resort option.

help.title: Stop service
paragraphs: Sign in to stop your service online; register first if you do not have an online account. Online stops are available for 13-digit account numbers, and customers with a 5-digit account number should contact us. You can also call 1-800-362-7557, Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
Give at least 7 business days notice when possible. Any deposit is credited to your account with interest and any remaining credit is refunded by check.
